_note: Test caller lines. K1-K3 (Korean) and C1-C7 (English) follow the demo script (design section 8). WAVs are generated locally by make-voice-lines.ps1 (Windows built-in voices) and are not committed. "ssml" overrides "text" for the synthesizer (C2b has the 1.2 s pause).

lines.text: 망원시장 근처에서 라멘집 하는데요, 평일 점심이 너무 비어요.
블로그 체험단은 해 봤고요, 예산은 한 달에 오십, 아니 사십팔만 원 정도요.
Hi. I run a small ramen place near Mangwon Market. We opened in the spring. Weekends are fine, but weekday lunch is empty.
Maybe four or five hundred thousand won a month.

lines.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-US">Four hundred <break time="1200ms"/> eighty thousand.</speak>

lines.text: Wait. Cut it to three hundred eighty thousand. And can you take twenty percent off?
